value.rationale: The naturally motivated entire random face-vector law is a structural statistical classification, not merely an expected-value formula. The rank-uniform one-sided near-vertex law gives exact finite-dimensional masses and mean/variance, while the nondegenerate high-dimensional limit exhibits order-d^2 fluctuations and a universal explicit CDF. These are meaningful quantitative benchmark results for stochastic sections and expose a phenomenon hidden by expectation-only studies.
